selection_rule: From current options and stats, take unscaled active USDT native markets with explicit positive increments/minimum, isClosed exactly false, and positive reported volumeDst. Rank descending Decimal volumeDst, then ascending native symbol; keep first twenty. Preserve every exclusion. This reported 24-hour statistic has no source clock and is only an initial ranking input, never a fresh execution signal.
network_budget: One public options GET, one public all-market stats GET, ten all-book GETs spaced at least thirty seconds after each preceding book response, then one recent-trades GET for each selected native symbol spaced at least two seconds after each preceding trade response. At most thirty-two public GETs, no retry, replacement, refresh, WebSocket or private request.
capture_policy: Select the twenty-market maximum before requesting any book or recent trade list for this study. Preserve raw bodies, hashes, wall/monotonic timing, fixed request order and terminal reason. Source-wide/transport/clock/storage failure stops without retry. Per-market missing or invalid data stay excluded. Do not expand the selection or duration after seeing results.
activity_semantics: Per-symbol recent REST list only. Count rows and distinct exact time/price/volume/raw-type fingerprints with positive volume and source time within the last 300 seconds at that response availability. This is a finite-list activity indicator, not unique exchange trade IDs, complete flow, venue volume or a fill. Keep zero volume and duplicate occurrence counts explicit.
comparison_policy: Use unchanged maker-spread-v1 received-asset fees, reserves, synthetic quote footprint, increments, minimums and freshness checks on all ten source-time-verified books. Keep all stale/missing/below-minimum comparisons. Calculate no fills or portfolio returns.

follow_up_rule.ranking: descending recent distinct positive fingerprints, then descending median stressed width per spent USDT, then ascending native symbol
follow_up_rule.permission: Separately registered prospective book/trade measurement only; never paper strategy or live acceptance.

causality: Initial membership is fixed before books/trades. Quote metrics use their own receive/availability time. Recent lists arrive after the book series; they are available only to the final follow-up decision, not retroactively to historical orders or individual quote decisions. Book and activity windows need not coincide and remain separately timestamped.
fee_scope: Public base USDT maker fee 0.1 percent rechecked 2026-11-17. Same base/stress assumptions as pinned quote plan, not account-specific or historical tiers.
registration_state: No current options, market stats, all-book snapshot or selected recent-trades list has been requested for this study before registration. Prior maker observations and trade-route controls are known; this is a new fixed activity-aware feasibility screen, not independent strategy validation.
limitations: Only current metadata, reported aggregate activity and sparse quotes. Listing/survivorship bias, unknown stats source age, finite REST lists, uncertain cross-source trade volumes, absent queue identity/fills, inventory and adverse-selection costs remain. No fiat conversion, owner settings, leverage, account changes or live order route.
